subject: tu:game/sound/sounds
value:
Controlled sound-boundary experiments at 67b0fca5e470ef0e034c179de1852ab4ce613a20 distinguish a real data-context deficit from an unproved historical TU boundary. No production source, splits, compiler settings, postprocessor rules or object bodies changed. This refutes the SM record's NECESSITY inference, not the possibility that the two GC text runs originally formed one object.

BASELINE FIDELITY: r67_sound_boundary_probe.py reconstructs both full raw objects from their actual Ninja edges before attempting variants. GC/1.2.5, cflags_demo; sounds_evt SHA256 d16b6424ae775135bb9952cbf14f9029a69acb16a17d367e195da60788598fe1, sounds d907799ae90b1b947f970d6e890125c45820a498d00476c510703f7f9e64a449. Both byte-identical. The script refuses variants if either reproduction differs.

MERGE CONTROL: concatenate evt then sounds after correcting the two conflicting, unused-return declarations (AudioWithName int->void; sndFxPlay3DTracked void->int), and undefine offsetof at the seam. Separate declaration controls preserve 118/118 and 33/33 raw function bodies. The merged source preserves 151/151 raw unrelocated function bodies, both with inherited evt optimization pragmas and with explicit resets at the seam. Thus the tested merge has neither a discovered inlining regression nor a raw code improvement. Relocation payloads and final layout remain separate obligations. AudioSetupBossStreams stays target826/ours827 with one extra mr; AudioBuildMusicName stays112/113 with one extra addi. These are finite source-context observations, not compiler impossibility proofs.

THE MISSING PREFIX IS DATA, NOT 29 OTHER FUNCTION LITERALS: the retail 348-byte .rodata prefix at 0x80114A48..0x80114BA4 contains 27 long filenames. The 32-pointer table at 0x8012331C refers to all 27 plus five short strings in .sdata2. Census is restricted to current config.json units and includes initialized-data relocations; no missing current asm files in this run. Its prefix references belong to AudioSetupBossStreams, AudioBuildMusicName and extractor data object lbl_8012330C. Older all-asm searches can include stale split artifacts.

POSITIVE FULL-TU CONTROL: emit that real 32-pointer table before evt and replace all 19 BossStreams formats+offset uses with ordinary string literals, deleting the formats local. All 118/118 raw function bodies remain byte-identical, while BossStreams now binds its own ...rodata.0 at the same zero addend instead of undefined lbl_80114A48. The 521 emitted .rodata bytes exactly reproduce retail; the final three bytes of aligned section padding are not emitted in this isolated object. With the merged fixture the first524 bytes are exact, and151/151 raw bodies still agree. This resolves the earlier literalization regression through missing-data context WITHOUT requiring a merge for that local result. It does not close the remaining extra mr, certify all relocation payloads, or justify placing an otherwise unused table into evt production source.

CONTENTS AND TYPES: the five independent arrays pantab int[5], elev_desc char[6][8], letter char[16], MovieBanks char*[32], and MovieMusic int[32] reconstruct all340 bytes at 0x801232C8..0x8012341C exactly after resolving32 own-section ADDR32 pointers at measured retail bases. Both literal sections are also exact. The diagnostic fixture's relocated data SHA256 is506c0644a44fe3b44348e067a340a8273d08f804b77436feddd2a7bae69bdbe0. PDB2 TPI confirms these types and S_LDATA32_ST module-local symbols in SOUNDS.OBJ, PDB SHA2564d5d694a9b6275b9a521f77c9c26168c7b6586d052960f8aaad14e10452c7b64. MovieBanks is the pointer table; MovieMusic is the integer flags, not the filenames. Type-code interpretation was checked against Microsoft's microsoft-pdb/include/cvinfo.h (T_RCHAR0x70, T_INT4 0x74, T_32PRCHAR0x470, LF_ARRAY_ST0x1003, S_LDATA32_ST0x1007).

BOUNDARY LIMIT: ordinary identical literals in two synthetic separately compiled objects remain two copies under the configured GC/1.3.2 linker; explicit shared const storage produces a single shared address across two objects. Therefore a shared address alone does not prove a single TU. The original sounds grouping remains plausible from contiguous code/EH and Xbox module evidence but unresolved. The stronger next investigation is complete, independently typed .data/.rodata ownership and natural pooling context: target AudioPlayerEatFood materializes lbl_801232C8 at +0x1c/+0x20 and reads actual sound tables at +0x2bc/+0x33c; these accesses cross the movie-table island. They need not imply one giant source struct. The new pooling-retention control proves why absence of a direct MovieBanks xref does not prove artificial or dead source data.
